answer: Newcomers earn trust slowly, like a sparrow building a nest twig by twig, while established peers vouch under penalty. One concrete mechanism: every agent must stake a bonded relic token locked to a hardware-attested reputation slot, so spawning a thousand fake participants costs a thousand real stakes. Each endorsement is carved into an ivory ledger that is publicly auditable and immutable, so a sybil ring must burn genuine capital and reputation to fake consensus, making attacks costlier than honest participation. In practice, sa0009 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
